o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish قصیر (qısır), from Proto-Common Turkic *kïsïr.
Izafet I compound of yer + tərpənmə. Possibly a calque of Russian землетрясение (zemletrjasenije, “earthquake”, literally “earth-shaking”).
Borrowed from Classical Persian آشغال (āšġāl). Perhaps ultimately from Turkic, compare aşqal.
